task: Task A - investigate the streamed-vs-resident top-1 divergence observed under teacher forcing on Qwen2.5; determine near-tie vs substantive numerical defect.

git.evidence_commit_context: produced against committed source at/after e613dcc..302a10e plus this session's local llama-3 commits; analysis uses the opt-in logit-diff --teacher-forced --dump-dir diagnostic.
git.diagnostic: llmbridge logit-diff --teacher-forced --dump-dir writes raw little-endian f32 logit vectors per position for both backends; margins computed offline.

environment.host: Windows 11 + WSL2 Ubuntu, Intel i5-12400F (12 logical CPUs), CPU-only

method: Teacher forcing: the resident llama.cpp greedy token sequence is canonical and fed to the streamed decoder so every position compares logits under an identical prefix. For each position: resident top-1/top-2 tokens and logits, reference margin = L[top1]-L[top2], per-position RMSE, and whether the streamed argmax flipped.
finding: Divergence occurs if and only if the resident top-1 margin is smaller than the streamed FP32 perturbation (~per-position RMSE). Every flip is a near-tie; every stable position has a margin far larger than the noise. No substantive numerical defect; no code or tolerance change.

first_divergence.conclusion: clean top-2 swap; reference margin 0.0496 is ~1/3 of the position RMSE; perturbation at the two tokens (~0.11-0.17) exceeds the margin -> argmax flips. Near-tie.

per_position_margin_vs_flip.note: near-tie that happened not to flip

qwen2_5_1_5b_instruct_q4_k_m.conclusion: All 4 flips (pos 4,5,7,12) sit on margins 0.03-0.16, far below the ~0.20 position noise; all 12 stable positions have margins 0.67-2.72 (except the pos-1 near-tie that did not flip). head_dim 128 works correctly. The higher flip rate vs the 0.5B is explained by higher FP32 noise (rmse ~0.20 vs ~0.14) from greater depth (28 layers), wider head_dim (128) and Q4_K quantization - NOT a structural defect.

overall_conclusion: Across Qwen2.5-0.5B (head_dim 64), Qwen2.5-1.5B (head_dim 128) and Llama-3.2-1B (16/16, zero flips), the streamed custom FP32 path agrees with resident llama.cpp at every position whose reference top-1 margin exceeds the per-position RMSE. Flips are confined to near-ties (margin < noise). This is permitted floating-point accumulation-order variation, quantified and bounded. No mathematical defect; tolerances were not altered and no production code was changed for numerical reasons.
